palette.primary_role: Page background (white/off-white dominant to let images breathe, dark option for editorial)
palette.accent_role: Text and UI elements (black dominant), subtle gold/copper for pricing and premium touches
palette.surface_role: Card backgrounds (white/light gray, optional dark for editorial), gallery overlays
palette.neutral_role: Secondary text, captions, metadata, navigation, subtle dividers
palette.border_role: Gallery image borders, card borders, input fields (ultra-subtle, nearly invisible)

card_padding.typical: 0px (image cards typically borderless, text cards 24px padding)

border_radius.typical_card: 0px - 2px (images should not have rounded corners that crop composition)

button_styles.text: Book a Session, Inquire, View Portfolio, Contact Me
View Gallery, See Pricing, About Me

elevation.approach: Avoid shadows that compete with imagery. When needed, barely-there shadows. Images themselves are the hero — UI recedes.

typical_order: header (minimal: logo/name center or left, nav with thin text links, transparent or white bg, no sticky unless essential)
hero (full-bleed hero photograph + photographer name + tagline + subtle 'View Portfolio' CTA — text minimal)
portfolio_grid (masonry or clean grid of best work, 3-4 columns, lightbox on click, category filters: weddings/portraits/commercial)
services (minimal icon-free cards: photography type + short description + starting price, 3 columns)
about_photographer (split layout: photographer portrait left, story/approach right, warm personal tone)
testimonials (minimal quote cards: 'Client Name — Event/Location', elegant serif quotes, carousel or spaced grid)
booking_cta (centered, generous whitespace, 'Let's Create Something Beautiful' + contact form or 'Inquire' button)
footer (minimal: name/logo, Instagram grid preview, contact email, social icons, copyright — understated)
hero_variants: full_bleed_single (Magnum style — one breathtaking full-viewport photo, photographer name bottom-center, minimal text)
slideshow_carousel (portfolio style — auto-advancing full-bleed images, subtle dot navigation, no text overlay)
split_portrait (personal brand style — photographer portrait right, name + tagline left, clean white bg)
grid_intro (500px style — grid of 6 best images tiled above fold, logo centered on white)
feature_card_variants: portfolio_thumbnail (image only with overlay on hover: title + category, lightbox trigger, no border)
service_card (thin-bordered or shadowless card: service name + brief description + starting price, minimal)
testimonial_quote (no photo card: centered italic quote + client name, editorial typography, generous padding)
pricing_tier (3-column: package name + hours + deliverables list + price, minimalist table style)

tone_profile.headline_style: poetic and personal, 4-7 words (e.g., 'Capturing Light. Preserving Moments.', 'Timeless Imagery for Modern Love.')
tone_profile.cta_style: gentle, invitational (Inquire, Book a Session, Let's Connect, View Portfolio, Get in Touch)
trust_signals: featured publication logos (Vogue, The Knot, etc.)
anti_patterns: loud CTA buttons that compete with photos

color_mood: pure_white_minimal (#ffffff bg, #000000 text, #f5f5f5 secondary — gallery-first, no distraction)
warm_editorial (#faf8f5 warm white, #2c2416 sepia text, #c9a96e gold accent — film photography, fine art)
dark_gallery (#0a0a0a bg, #f0f0f0 text, #ffffff — editorial dark mode, dramatic imagery)
soft_cream (#fdfbf7 cream, #3a3a3a charcoal, #d4a574 copper — wedding/portrait photographers, romantic)
mono_contrast (#ffffff bg, #000000 text, #e5e5e5 borders — stark, modern, fashion/editorial)
typography_mood: cormorant_timeless (Cormorant Garamond headings, Jost body — editorial, wedding, fine art photography)
playfair_classic (Playfair Display headings, Lato body — polished, traditional, portrait photographers)
jost_modern (Jost headings and body — clean geometric, modern commercial/architecture photographers)
layout_density: gallery_maximal (dense image grid, minimal text, images do all the talking — 500px/Unsplash style)
editorial_airy (generous whitespace, large type, one image per screen — fine art/editorial photographers)
business_balanced (clear service sections, pricing visible, booking accessible — working commercial photographers)

portfolio_page.best_practices: Masonry or clean grid, category filters (All/Weddings/Portraits/Commercial), lazy loading with blur-up placeholders, lightbox with keyboard navigation

pricing_page.best_practices: 3-4 package tiers, clear deliverables list, starting price, FAQ accordion, no hard sell
